name: AlphaCommerce – Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: AlphaCommerce

sections.description:
70% of your customers leave checkout without paying. That’s real revenue disappearing every single day.

Most cart recovery plugins make you configure templates, connect to cloud services, and read documentation before anything happens. Many lock their best features behind a Pro upgrade. Some charge $99–$199/year just for multi-step email sequences.

AlphaCommerce works the moment you activate it. No wizard. No configuration. No cloud. No paywall. Your first recovery email goes out 30 minutes after your next abandoned cart — without you touching a single setting.

🛒 How AlphaCommerce recovers your revenue

  1. A customer adds items to their cart and enters their email at checkout — guest or logged-in, doesn’t matter.
  2. If they leave without paying, AlphaCommerce captures the cart instantly.
  3. A 3-step email sequence fires automatically — at 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 48 hours.
  4. The customer clicks one link to restore their exact cart and complete checkout.
  5. When the order is placed, AlphaCommerce detects the conversion and stops the sequence. No duplicate emails. No awkward follow-ups after a completed purchase.

⚡ Everything below is free. All of it.

Other plugins gate these behind paid tiers. AlphaCommerce ships them on day one.

📧 Automatic 3-step recovery emails
A battle-tested sequence at 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 48 hours. Professionally designed, conversion-optimized templates — ready to send the moment you activate. No template editor to wrestle with. No copy to write.

📊 Full analytics dashboard
Recovered revenue. Recovery rate. Abandoned cart count. Recoverable orders. A 30-day revenue trend chart showing potential vs recovered revenue. Recent activity feed with customer details, cart totals, and recovery status — all updating in real time.

📈 Product performance reports
See your top abandoned products ranked by quantity and your top recovered products ranked by recovered value. Know exactly which products your customers leave behind — and which ones are coming back. Other plugins charge for per-product analytics. This is free.

🔗 One-click cart restoration
Every recovery email contains a unique, time-limited link that rebuilds the customer’s exact cart — products, quantities, selections — and drops them into checkout. No login required.

🎟️ Smart recovery coupons
Add a coupon code to recovery emails to incentivize completion. Enter any existing WooCommerce coupon — or type a new code and AlphaCommerce auto-creates it as a 10% discount. Coupons are excluded from the first email and only appear in the 24h and 48h follow-ups to protect your margins.

✉️ Custom email sender details
Set your own sender name, sender email address, and reply-to address. Recovery emails come from your brand, not a generic WordPress address. Preview your emails visually, and send yourself a test email to verify delivery and layout before anything goes live.

🔒 GDPR compliance built in
Enable a mandatory consent checkbox on checkout with one toggle. Customize the consent message text. Every recovery email includes a one-click unsubscribe link. Capture only happens after consent is given.

🚫 Email domain blocking
Spam bots fill out checkout forms with junk. Block entire domains — one per line — and AlphaCommerce silently ignores them. Supports subdomain wildcards with dot-prefix notation. Other plugins call this “advanced filtering” and charge for it.

👤 Role-based exclusions
Exclude administrators, shop managers, editors, or any WordPress role from cart tracking. Your test orders and internal activity never pollute your recovery data.

⚙️ Configurable recovery rules
Choose exactly which WooCommerce order statuses stop recovery emails — pending payment, processing, completed, or any combination. Full control over when a cart is considered recovered.

🔔 Merchant recovery notifications
Get an email alert the moment a cart is successfully recovered. Know exactly when revenue comes back.

📬 Weekly recovery reports
Automated performance reports delivered to one or more email addresses on a weekly schedule. Stay on top of recovery metrics without logging in.

📌 WordPress dashboard widget
Recovery stats on your main WordPress dashboard. Check performance at a glance without opening the plugin.

❓ Built-in Help & FAQ
Answers to common questions are built right into the plugin — how the recovery engine works, coupon setup, GDPR configuration, email testing, delivery troubleshooting. No searching through external docs.

👥 Guest and logged-in capture
AlphaCommerce captures every cart the moment an email is entered at checkout — guest visitors and registered customers alike.

✅ Classic and block checkout support
Works with both WooCommerce checkout experiences out of the box.

🏠 100% local. Zero cloud dependency.
Every piece of data — carts, emails, metrics, restore tokens — lives in your WordPress database. No external service stores your customer information. No cloud server to go down. No vendor lock-in. No usage tracking. Your data is yours.

🆚 How AlphaCommerce compares

Features other plugins lock behind Pro tiers or mark “coming soon” — AlphaCommerce includes for free:

✅ Multi-step email sequences — Free
✅ Per-product recovery reports — Free
✅ Smart coupon codes with auto-creation — Free
✅ Email domain blocking — Free
✅ Recovery exclusion rules — Free
✅ Admin recovery notifications — Free (others: “Coming Soon”)
✅ Custom sender name and reply-to — Free
✅ Weekly performance reports — Free
✅ No external service required — Free
✅ No usage tracking or data collection — Free

💡 Why zero configuration matters

Other plugins give you 30 settings and call it “flexible.” AlphaCommerce gives you zero required settings and calls it “done.” The defaults are tuned for maximum recovery. Advanced options exist if you want them — but you never need to touch them.

60 seconds from install to recovering carts. Not 10 minutes. Not “easy setup.” Sixty seconds.

🏁 Stop losing sales

Every hour without cart recovery, revenue walks out the door. AlphaCommerce is the fastest way to get it back — and it costs you nothing.

Activate it. Walk away. Watch revenue come back.

External Services

This plugin sends a one-time, non-blocking request to https://alphacommerce.io/api/ping/activate on first activation. Only your site URL and version info are sent — no personal or customer data. Terms | Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. That’s it. Recovery is already running.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything?

No. AlphaCommerce starts recovering carts the moment you activate it. Default settings are optimized for maximum recovery. Advanced options are available if you want to fine-tune, but they’re completely optional.

Does it capture guest carts?

Yes. AlphaCommerce captures carts from both guest visitors and logged-in customers as soon as they enter their email on the checkout page.

Does it send emails automatically?

Yes. A 3-step recovery sequence fires automatically using WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler — at 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 48 hours after abandonment.

How do recovery coupons work?

Go to the Settings tab and enable the recovery coupon. Enter any existing WooCommerce coupon code, or type a new code — AlphaCommerce will auto-create it as a 10% discount. Coupons only appear in the 24h and 48h follow-ups to protect your margins.

How do I test my recovery emails?

Two ways. Use the Email Preview button on the Dashboard for a quick visual check. Or go to Recovery Email Setup, enter your address, and click “Send Test to Me” for a real delivery test.

What happens when a customer completes their order?

AlphaCommerce detects the order and immediately stops recovery emails for that cart. You can configure which order statuses trigger this in Settings.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Yes. Enable “Privacy Consent” in Settings to add a mandatory consent checkbox at checkout. Customize the message text. Emails only send after consent is given, and every email includes a one-click unsubscribe.

How much does it cost?

Nothing. Every feature on this page is free. No locked features, no trial periods, no limits on carts recovered.

Where is my data stored?

All data lives in your WordPress database. Nothing is sent to an external service for recovery purposes.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

Cart recovery data is preserved in the database on deactivation or deletion. You never lose historical data. Plugin settings are cleaned up on uninstall.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. AlphaCommerce works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme and supports both classic and block checkout.

Why aren’t my test emails arriving?

This usually means your server’s mail configuration needs attention. We recommend a dedicated SMTP plugin like WP Mail SMTP for reliable delivery.

Will it slow down my checkout?

No. Cart capture uses lightweight, rate-limited background requests. It never blocks or delays checkout.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Removed Abilities API dependency — plugin no longer requires WP 6.9 Abilities framework.
  • Cart snapshot builder moved into Capture class (self-contained, no external dependencies).
  • Added conversion safety nets: woocommerce_checkout_order_created, store API, and thank-you page hooks.
  • Capture now blocked during active order processing to prevent phantom rows.
  • Added debug logging (WP_DEBUG only) for conversion flow diagnostics.

1.0.12

  • Performance: daily trend chart now uses 2 SQL queries instead of 60.
  • Performance: admin metrics only loaded on Dashboard and Reports tabs.
  • Performance: cached DB version check to avoid repeated get_option calls.
  • Removed dead code: 4 unused functions, dead variables, dead CSS.
  • Fixed deactivation hook to properly clear Action Scheduler recurring jobs.
  • Fixed uninstall to clean up all plugin options and drop custom table.
  • Consolidated duplicated email header construction into shared helper.
  • Fixed inconsistent time function usage in token expiry checks.
  • Added class_exists guard in unsubscribe handler.

1.0.11

  • Fixed admin recovery notification not firing when abandoned carts are recovered via checkout.
  • Fixed default “Stop Recovery On Status” to include On Hold for BACS/bank transfer support.

1.0.10

  • Fixed settings bug: saving on one tab no longer clears settings on other tabs.

1.0.9

  • Fixed converted orders displaying as “Monitoring” in Recent Activity (missing status label + no query filter).

1.0.7

  • Fixed race condition: cart capture can no longer overwrite a converted/recovered status during concurrent checkout.

1.0.6

  • Fixed race condition: email sends can no longer overwrite terminal cart statuses.
  • Fixed abandoned carts resetting to “Monitoring” when customer revisits checkout.
  • Fixed premature recovery: restore link click no longer marks cart as recovered before purchase.
  • Fixed JS capture firing during checkout submission, preventing post-order phantom rows.
  • Added duplicate conversion guard to prevent redundant processing from multiple WooCommerce hooks.

1.0.5

  • Fixed phantom “Monitoring” rows appearing after completed orders.

1.0.4

  • Fixed critical bug: completed orders no longer reset to “Monitoring” status.
  • Fixed cart hash collision: returning customers buying the same products are now tracked correctly.
  • Fixed unsubscribe: links no longer expire after 24 hours; uses permanent HMAC signatures.
  • Fixed suppression list: unsubscribed emails are now blocked at capture and send time.
  • Added terminal status guards to prevent any status transition from overwriting final states.
  • Added on-hold to default conversion statuses for BACS/bank transfer support.
  • Added WooCommerce plugin dependency header.

1.0.3

  • Fixed false recovery metrics: normal checkouts are no longer counted as recovered carts.

1.0.2

  • Added spam prevention: email guard and domain blocklist.
  • Updated admin branding and email template styling.
  • Lowered minimum WordPress requirement from 6.9 to 6.2.
  • Build pipeline: added package.ps1 and deploy-trunk.ps1 scripts.

1.0.1

  • Added activation ping for install tracking.
  • Minor code quality improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Multi-step recovery engine.
  • 30-day performance dashboard.
  • GDPR and unsubscribe features.
